verdict.rationale: Modal is a serverless GPU compute platform, so SSH access and root control over a GPU environment is a fair axis for it. However, the evidence pack never mentions SSH access, bringing your own keys, or root-level control. The evidence covers only GPU selection, containers, Sandboxes, SDKs and the CLI, none of which documents this capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can SSH into my GPU instance with my own keys and get root-level control of the environment
